rules.title: Roadway excavation geometric quantity
inclusion_rules: Average design section area × length: 12.0 m2 × 100.0 m = 1200 m3
exclusion_rules: No over-excavation, swell, haulage or payment allowance included
rules.rounding_policy: Display 3 decimals for quantities; monetary calculation unrounded until report display (simulation only).
rules.notes: Geometry intentionally simplified; actual earthworks require section-by-section measurements and contract rules.

rules.title: Granular subbase geometric volume
exclusion_rules: No shrinkage, compaction factor or waste allowance included
rules.rounding_policy: Display 3 decimals for quantities; monetary calculation unrounded until report display (simulation only).
rules.notes: Thickness is illustrative and must not be used as a real design parameter.

rules.title: Asphalt concrete geometric volume
exclusion_rules: No density conversion, tonnage payment or waste allowance included
rules.rounding_policy: Display 3 decimals for quantities; monetary calculation unrounded until report display (simulation only).
rules.notes: Many contracts pay asphalt by mass or another basis; this simulation deliberately uses geometric m3 and is not prescriptive.

rules.title: Box culvert concrete by distinct component
inclusion_rules: Base slab 3.60 m3; two walls 3.60 m3; top slab 3.60 m3
exclusion_rules: No deductions for openings or intersections modelled; steel/formwork excluded
rules.rounding_policy: Display 3 decimals for quantities; monetary calculation unrounded until report display (simulation only).
rules.notes: Components are coded separately to avoid overlap/double counting; verify dimensions and void rules in a real project.

rules.title: Optional guardrail length
exclusion_rules: Excluded from base direct cost; priced separately as CPB 4.0 OPTIONS
rules.rounding_policy: Display 3 decimals for quantities; monetary calculation unrounded until report display (simulation only).
rules.notes: Optional scope is intentionally separated to test option gating.
